paper_title: Axion and dark photon limits from Crab Nebula high energy gamma-rays
suggested_experiment_name: Crab Nebula gamma-rays (Tibet ASgamma + HAWC + HEGRA + MAGIC)
coupling_convention: g_agamma-gamma in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 3
notes: Paper derives 95% C.L. exclusion limits on ALP-photon coupling from combined Tibet AS-gamma, HAWC, HEGRA and MAGIC observations of Crab Nebula sub-PeV gamma rays via photon-ALP oscillation in the Galactic magnetic field (Jansson-Farrar model, avg B_T ~1.3 uG). The text explicitly states g_agamma < 1.8e-10 GeV^-1 for ALP mass in the most constrained range 2e-7 to 6e-7 eV; encoded as a two-point flat bound over that range. Full exclusion contour (Fig. 3) extends over roughly 1e-9 to 1e-5 eV but numerical values are not provided outside the quoted range. The paper also constrains dark photon kinetic mixing (eps < ~1e-3 for mD 0.01-1 eV, assuming rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3), which would be a separate DarkPhoton entry; the primary/strongest result reported here is the AxionPhoton limit.
